0022600220.text: The San Antonio Spurs (9-2, 1st in the Southwest) ride a nine-game winning streak into Chicago, where they are 5-0 on the road and 9-1 over their last ten. The Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) have lost seven straight and are 0-3 at home. Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out for San Antonio, and Devin Vassell (groin) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Chicago's Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), Tobe Awaka (back) and Zach Collins (illness) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions. There have been no meetings yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Spurs swept both games against Chicago in 2025-26, most recently winning 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026.
